recent_game.fact: Wake Forest defeated Purdue 38-36 in double overtime on Sept. 12, 2026, improving to 2-0.
On fourth-and-15 in the second overtime, Gio Lopez completed a 15-yard pass to Carlos Hernandez to extend the game, then rushed for the tying touchdown and winning two-point conversion.
Against Purdue, Lopez completed 16 of 27 passes for 225 yards and one touchdown and led Wake Forest with 59 rushing yards and two rushing touchdowns.
Carlos Hernandez caught six passes for 88 yards against Purdue.
Wake Forest committed no turnovers against Purdue.
Purdue quarterback Ryan Browne passed for 329 yards, while running back Fame Ijeboi rushed 27 times for 114 yards and three touchdowns against Wake Forest.

quarterback.fact: Gio Lopez is Wake Forest's starting quarterback and a team captain after transferring from North Carolina.
Through two 2026 games, Lopez completed 37 of 59 passes for 575 yards, four touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing 20 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns.
Lopez previously played under current Wake Forest offensive coordinator Rob Ezell at South Alabama.
While starting for North Carolina against Stanford in 2025, Lopez completed 18 of 25 passes for 203 yards and two touchdowns and had seven rushing attempts for minus-six yards.
Redshirt freshman Steele Pizzella is listed as the backup quarterback on Wake Forest's unofficial projected depth chart.
